capabilities: create collections of regex find/replace rules that run in sequence
apply patterns to selections, whole lines, whole documents, or the clipboard
insert natural-language dates and date ranges via {{date}} syntax
create custom commands that run one or more patterns
import and export patterns through the system clipboard
extras: The README's Todo section asks for help adding automated tests using Obsidian's end-to-end testing approach.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to save and run multi-step regex find/replace rule sets on note text.

relations.evidence: start and end are both parsed using chrono-node.
format can be any format from DayJS.

summary: Rule-based tool that applies collections of regex find/replace patterns in sequence to selections, whole lines, whole documents, or the clipboard.
